description: This is a Python script for a command-line interface (CLI) tool called 'Universal Project Initializer'. It handles argument parsing, project configuration creation, template generation, and project initialization, with detailed output and error handling.

classes.name: TemplateInitInfo
classes.description: Holds configuration details for project initialization templates.

classes.name: ProjectConfig
classes.description: Represents the configuration of a project to be initialized.

classes.name: ProjectType
classes.description: Enumeration or class for different project types, with a method to parse from string.

classes.name: ProjectInitializer
classes.description: Main class responsible for creating templates and initializing projects.

methods.name: parse_parameters
methods.description: Parses a comma-separated string of key=value pairs into a dictionary with appropriate data types.

methods.name: create_project_config
methods.description: Creates a ProjectConfig object from CLI arguments.

methods.name: make_path_absolute
methods.description: Converts a relative path to an absolute path based on a base directory.

methods.name: template_init_info_to_dict
methods.description: Converts TemplateInitInfo object into a dictionary with absolute paths for serialization.

methods.name: output_json
methods.description: Outputs a JSON-formatted result indicating success or failure, with optional template info.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point for the CLI tool, handling argument parsing, project setup, and execution flow.
